jobs.role: Deputy Manager in Human Capital Management
jobs.company: YES Bank Ltd., Mumbai, Maharashtra Employee Risk & Controls
bullets: Monitoring of AMLOCK alerts for staff accounts to identify suspicious activity and are being financially disciplined.
Mitigated anti-money laundering (AML) risks by monitoring employee cash, non-cash, and staff-client fund transfer transactions.
Reviewed and controlled unauthorized access to staff account views, ensuring reporting authority approval or employee consent as per policy.
Examined for ECS NACH return cases due to insufficient funds and identifying patterns and reasons for non-payment.
Monitored and identified violations of IT Acceptable Usage Policy related to external email communications using Symantec Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
Conducting quarterly reviews for Staff flag, Vendor flag and Mnemonic Code to ensure compliance and regulatory requirements.
Processing Credit History (CIBIL) check for employees.
Conducted thorough Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screenings to identify and assess potential financial and reputational risks.
Reviewed and assessed employment relationships to ensure compliance with Banks policy and conflict of interest.

Conducted monthly reconciliation of insider trading information to ensure accuracy and completeness of employee trade data, prevent regulatory violations, and maintain compliance with fair disclosure practices.

Conducted comprehensive investigations of Fraud Prevention & Investigation Unit (FPIU) alerts, covering employee account activity, staff actions, transaction patterns, and system log analysis to ensure timely and accurate risk resolution.
Collaborated with cross functional teams for presenting monthly Key Risk Indicator (KRI) framework to improve risk controls.
Collaborating with Operational Risk Management Team and reporting for Risk and Control Self- Assessment (RCSA) cases.

Reviewed and assessed Business Continuity Planning (BCP) documentation to ensure alignment with organizational risk management strategies, regulatory requirements, and operational resilience standards.
Recommending changes to the process control environment or to business practices, where necessary to reduce the level of fraud risk exposure.
Training off roll resources on best practices and standardized process adherence.
Handled audit queries by providing timely and accurate responses to internal and external auditors.
Provide analytical MIS and reports to the management.
Handling special projects and other duties assigned by management.
Experience in verifying and updating employee Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal, transfer and settlement forms.
Conducted background checks for exited employees.
Managing queries related to exit letters and ensuring smooth offboarding.
